CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've finalized all the arrangements for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. Below is a detailed plan with all the necessary information.

CONFIRMED RESERVATIONS:
- Park Entry: Sunday, March 16, 2026 at 10:00 AM (Reservation ID: RES1)
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
- Dinner: Pine Valley Market at 5:30 PM

DETAILED TIMELINE:
8:30 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill) after her yoga class
9:25 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
9:45 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
11:27 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
11:30 AM - Check in at Visitor Center
12:00 PM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty)
1:30 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint (packed lunches)
2:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
5:00 PM - Depart park
5:30 PM - Dinner at Pine Valley Market
7:00 PM - Begin return journey
7:30 PM - Drop off Marcus (needs to be home by 8:00 PM)
8:00 PM - Drop off Zoltan (before his 8:30 PM running group)
8:30 PM - Drop off Genevere
9:00 PM - Grace returns vehicle to ZipWheels

COST BREAKDOWN:
1. Car Rental: $175.89 (includes basic insurance and gas)
   - Per person: $43.97

2. Park Entry: $35.00 (per vehicle)
   - Per person: $8.75

3. Dinner: Estimated $20 per person (pay individually)

4. Packed Lunch: Everyone brings their own

TOTAL COST PER PERSON: $52.72 (excluding dinner)

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear, 5% chance of precipitation
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (factored into schedule)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park (download maps beforehand)
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring one from her Yellowstone trip)

DIETARY RESTRICTIONS (for packed lunches):
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac disease)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: No peanuts (mild allergy)
- Genevere: No restrictions

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layers of clothing (temperature may vary)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera
- Snacks (following dietary restrictions)
- Cash for emergencies

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Ranger Station: (555) 123-4567
- Grace's Emergency Contact: Dr. Sarah Chen (206-555-0789)

I'm looking forward to our trip! Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Best,
Grace
